tasks.label: delete old parameter types
tasks.command: rm -f Parameters/DelegateParameter.cs Parameters/ParameterChoice.cs Parameters/ParameterInt.cs Parameters/ParameterIntInterval.cs Parameters/ParameterDouble.cs Parameters/ParameterDoubleInterval.cs Parameters/ParameterBool.cs Parameters/ParameterText.cs

tasks.label: strip xml docs
tasks.command: for f in $(git ls-files '*.cs' 2>/dev/null || find . -name '*.cs' -not -path '*/obj/*' -not -path '*/bin/*'); do perl -0pi -e 's{^[ \t]*///.*\n}{}gm' "$f"; done; grep -rn '///' --include='*.cs' . | grep -v '/obj/' | grep -v '/bin/' | head -20

tasks.label: strip all comments
build solution
tasks.command: dotnet build Gen_alg_stand.slnx -warnaserror 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning|Build succeeded|Build FAILED' | sed 's/\[.*//' | sort -u | head -30

tasks.label: other errors
tasks.command: dotnet build Gen_alg_stand.slnx 2>&1 | grep -E 'error' | grep -v ParameterSpec | grep -v ParameterKind | sed 's/\[.*//' | sort -u | head -20
